answer: Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through a relic debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the zenith totals, and the knoll anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 49 units per epoch, sustaining 40 aliases for 17 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the adversary. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
